tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Find upcoming live events in the UAE sold on TicketsMinistry: concerts, theatre, comedy, sports and more. Filter by free-text query, city, category and time window, or an exact date. Results are sorted by start time and give the date, venue, starting price, sale status and the event page url. Times

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Full details of one event from search_events: description, every ticket tier with its price and whether it is sold out, policies, venue map and the event page url. Tickets are bought by the person on the event page (url): checkout needs a signed-in account and card verification, so do not try to com

tools.name: list_categories_and_cities
tools.description: The categories, cities and venues that currently have upcoming events, with counts. Use the values as filters for search_events.

tools.name: search_help
tools.description: Search TicketsMinistry help articles for customers and organisers: buying tickets, getting e-tickets, refunds, payments, listing an event. Returns article titles, summaries and links.
